summary: Add frozen, resumable local Reference QA evaluation tasks for bounded ordered question sets and explicit one-question execution through the existing evidence loop.
decision_refs: Active goal: CRIP manages local task and result state around an advanced-model reference analyst
Evaluation tasks freeze snapshot, question order and non-secret model profile
Only an explicit per-question action may dispatch the existing QA V3 path
approval_evidence: The user requested continued implementation of CRIP as a standalone local management platform around advanced-model engineering-file analysis while retaining all existing features.
known_limitations: This slice executes one explicitly selected evaluation question per request; unattended whole-suite dispatch remains a future safety-gated feature.
Evaluation progress records answer and review states but does not automatically score engineering correctness.
The fixed 15-question live advanced-model quality benchmark is not run by offline implementation tests.
